## CHILD TICKETS FILED (this audit) — index

| ticket | title | tag | observable? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7d47-2131 (joyful-hominine-indianhare) | render_workflow MCP tool surfaces WorkflowError family as llm_unavailable | escalate | OBSERVABLE |
| fbc0-ee15 (bionic-impeccable-bats) | _structured_llm_failure hardcodes error=llm_unavailable for every LLMError across 4 gate tools | escalate | OBSERVABLE |
| 5f96-25aa (crucial-petaline-antbear) | error_code_for branch 6 maps deliberately-non-outage LLMRunnerError subclasses to llm_unavailable | ready-to-fix | latent (via error_code_for); root of the pattern |
| f75f-5509 (unadhesive-salaried-nightheron) | Gate degrade sets coverage.llm_unavailable=True for LLMInputRejectedError | escalate | OBSERVABLE |
| 0aee-a70d (immense-feedable-weevil) | pinned_ticket_read_failed emitted but absent from KNOWN_ERROR_CODES | ready-to-fix | OBSERVABLE |

All five are children of this epic (parent set). 7d47 additionally links relates_to 551b and 73d8 (the live MCP manifestation of that class). Pre-existing instances 551b and 73d8 remain the owners of the contended WorkflowError-family code decision; the audit did not duplicate them.

**Escalate design questions for the human:**
- 7d47 / 73d8 / 551b: which code should a workflow-file fault (missing / malformed / unsupported-version at LOAD time, and execute-time expression-resolution) return? New `workflow_invalid`/`workflow_not_found` vocab, reuse `command_failed`, or (execute-time only) keep `llm_unavailable` per dbca AC3?
- fbc0: should the MCP gate-tool top-level `error` field be derived from the exception subclass / `resolution_class` rather than hardcoded `llm_unavailable`, and under what shared vocabulary?
- f75f: should `coverage.llm_unavailable` be split into a neutral `degraded`/`no_provider_record` flag vs a strict outage flag (affects the verdict contract + 3 consumers)?
